verdicts.reason: HOL4's Defn parser (Defn.sml defn_absyn_to_term) typechecks each clause separately and unifies only the head symbol and non-pattern frees. So the reused pattern variables h,t in clauses 2 and 3 do not identify the element types. The principal type is ('a->'b->ordering)->'a list->'b list->ordering. Lean's f : α→α→Ordering defines only the 'b='a instance, so heterogeneous instances such as f : num->bool->ordering have no counterpart. This is a special case of the HOL4 constant.
